title: Redesign: Uploaded file history
question: The upload-history page keeps its paper-ledger identity but needs a new structure. Three recompositions are on the table — lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Triage Queue
options.lineage: ops review inboxes / support triage queues
options.thesis: The page leads with what needs fixing — unmapped accounts, mixed accounts, anomalies — and the clean ledger becomes the archive beneath.
options.viewport: Attention strip first: three issue groups (Unmapped accounts 2, Mixed accounts 1, Check totals 1), each expandable to rows with the fix inline — assign account, review, delete. The full ledger sits below as the archive.
options.risk: Two stacked regions can feel heavy on a clean day; the queue must collapse to a slim strip when there is nothing to fix.

options.label: Coverage Board
options.thesis: A months × bank-account grid shows every gap in ingestion at one glance; clicking a cell or row drives the ledger below.
options.viewport: Year selector beside a coverage strip: one row per bank+account, twelve month cells per row, filled tick per uploaded month, amber tick where mixed, red where unmapped, hollow where missing. Ledger below answers to strip selection.
options.risk: Earns its keep while accounts stay few; many accounts would crowd the strip.

options.label: Workbench Grid
options.thesis: One full-bleed instrument: filters live in the sticky table header, aggregates in a pinned footer, nothing between you and the rows.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge dense grid: bank / year / status filters set into the header row, mono right-aligned DB and CR columns, per-row status rule on the left edge, aggregate footer (files, txns, DB, CR) always visible.
options.risk: Density-first can overwhelm the least expert users in the mix; needs disciplined grouping to stay scannable.
